Messages.Author: Madman2001
Messages.Body:
According to the Wizards' spoiler, Hidden Pathways says that "Your
minions get +1 stealth when attempting non-bleeding actions directed at
your prey". What sort of actions could there be that are directed at
your prey, except bleeding? Or does this mean that "non-bleeding
actions directed at your prey [or his or her permanents]" get +1
stealth? This phrasing would include acting nasty toward one's prey's
minions, or locations, or equipment.

Help me out, please.

And thank you,
Madman

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>What sort of actions could there be that are directed at
>your prey, except bleeding? Or does this mean that "non-bleeding
>actions directed at your prey [or his or her permanents]" get +1
>stealth? This phrasing would include acting nasty toward one's prey's
>minions, or locations, or equipment.

I'm pretty sure you're right on this last point. You'll get the +1 stealth on
any D, directed action, which is only blockable by your prey (includes Bum's
Rushes, Arsons, and other fun things like that). As for the particular wording
of "directed at your prey," I think there was a similar interpretation about
Protected Resources, which prevents "other Methusaleh's" from bleeding you for
more than 2. But that has obviously been interpreted as other's minions
bleeding you, and so Hidden Pathway will be interpreted similarly.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Body:

Correct. Actions directed at cards/counters that a Methuselah controls are
directed at that Methuselah.
